_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for the r2 C0/C1 control character proof (issue #1931). Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF.

expectedRed.testName: U+0001 (SOH) renders blank — the bug the r1 predicate missed
expectedRed.why: On corrected code, \p{Cc} strips U+0001, the function returns the marker, and `rendered('\u0001')` equals 'NO_CAUSE' not '\u0001'. The assertion `expect(rendered('\u0001')).toBe('\u0001')` FAILS with AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, \p{Cc} has been dropped from the predicate and the bug is back.
